help_about_what_a: dopeIPTV is a free, open-source desktop IPTV player for Xtream Codes, M3U playlists and Stalker portals, and for the receivers, TV servers and media servers at home. It gives you a full EPG guide, live timeshift and catch-up TV, one-click recording, and multiview for up to nine channels at once — all in one native app built on the mpv engine.
help_about_free_a:
Yes. dopeIPTV is completely free and open source under the GPL-3.0 licence, with no ads, no tracking and no account required.

If you like the app, a tip or monthly support is much appreciated and helps keep it going.
help_about_heart_q: Why does a heart show by the logo now and then?
help_about_heart_a:
That is the app asking for your support — one week a month, and only once you have watched a few hours. The first day the heart has its colour; the rest of the week it is muted. Left alone, it goes when the week is over.

Clicking it opens the support page and ends the week. Hide for three months in the heart's right-click menu puts it away for three months, and I've supported for a year. With a supporter key it never asks, and it never shows in full screen, in TV mode, during private viewing or in a kids profile.

To turn it off for good, switch off Ask for support now and then under Settings → General. Support dopeIPTV stays in the menu and in About dopeIPTV.
help_about_channels_q: Does dopeIPTV provide IPTV channels or a subscription?
help_about_channels_a: No. dopeIPTV is only a player — it does not provide, sell or host any channels or content. You connect your own Xtream Codes, M3U or Stalker provider.
help_about_systems_q: Which operating systems does dopeIPTV support?
help_about_systems_a: dopeIPTV is built for Linux and also runs on macOS and Windows. Linux ships as an AppImage and a .deb (for x86_64 and ARM64) and as a Flatpak; macOS as a .dmg for Apple Silicon and one for Intel Macs; and Windows as an installer or a portable zip, for x64 and ARM64.
help_about_languages_q: What languages is dopeIPTV available in?
help_about_languages_a:
dopeIPTV is translated into these 27 languages. Arabic, Hebrew, Persian and Urdu mirror the whole layout, right to left.

help_tech_built_a:
dopeIPTV is free and open source under the GPL-3.0 licence — no ads, no tracking, no accounts. It's built with, and grateful to, these projects and services:

  • Playback — mpv & FFmpeg, via python-mpv
  • Interface — Qt & PyQt6
  • Casting — PyChromecast — Google Cast
  • Metadata & artwork — The Movie Database (TMDB)
  • Watched sync — Trakt
  • Licences — GPL-3.0 & third-party

This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB. This product uses the Trakt API but is not endorsed or certified by Trakt. All trademarks are the property of their respective owners.
help_tech_privacy_q: Does dopeIPTV show ads or track me?
help_tech_privacy_a:
No. dopeIPTV has no ads, no tracking and no accounts. Posters and descriptions come from TMDB – the app asks it with a title and year, never your logins or the address of your service. It is on from the start; choose Provider artwork under Settings → Posters & info to turn it off. Watched-history sync with Trakt or Simkl is used only if you connect it.

To look for a new version, the app asks dopeiptv.org now and then and fetches the update from there. The site counts how many updates are made, by version and system — never who makes them.

A copy of the app that someone else has changed does not use dopeiptv.org's services: checking for updates, settings sync, watch together and sending reports are only in the official app.
